description: Submit a listing to a BCA directory: vcs, aggregators, trading_bots, mcps, nft_communities, jobs, stablecoins or trading_yields. Required: contact_email, directory, listing_name, listing_url and description (20 to 2,000 characters). Free to submit (needs an API key; the free tier is enough), paid to be featured: each submission alerts the editors, who review it for fit and reply to contact_email by hand with featured listing pricing. Returns request_id, status and next_step.

contact_email.description: Required. Where the editorial team replies with featured listing pricing.

description.description: Required. What the listing is (20 to 2,000 characters).

listing_name.description: Required. Display name for the listing (2 to 200 characters).

listing_url.description: Required. Public http or https URL of the project or product.

name: submit_listing
